meta.name: caveman
meta.description: Ultra-compressed communication mode. Cuts token usage ~75% by speaking like caveman while keeping full technical accuracy. Supports intensity levels: lite, full (default), ultra, wenyan-lite, wenyan-full, wenyan-ultra. Use when user says "caveman mode", "talk like caveman", "use caveman", "less tokens", "be brief", or invokes /caveman. Also auto-triggers when token efficiency is requested.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用极简语言减少对话字数，节省令牌用量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望AI回复更简短、节省API费用
copy.tagline_en: Reduce conversation tokens by speaking in ultra-compressed mode
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want AI responses to be shorter and save API costs

howto.what: Claude 会用极简的原始人风格回复，去掉所有废话和客套话，只保留技术核心内容。支持多种压缩强度，默认是 full 级别。
howto.when: 当你说“caveman mode”、“talk like caveman”、“less tokens”等关键词，或要求节省 token 时触发。

say.note: Claude 会切换到默认的 full 级别压缩回复。

say.text: 用 caveman 解释数据库连接池
say.note: Claude 会以极简风格解释概念。

howto.what_en: Claude responds in ultra-compressed caveman style, dropping filler and pleasantries while keeping full technical accuracy. Supports intensity levels: lite, full (default), ultra, and wenyan variants.
howto.when_en: Triggered when user says "caveman mode", "talk like caveman", "less tokens", or similar phrases, or when token efficiency is requested.

say_en.note: Claude switches to default full compression.

say_en.text: Explain database connection pooling like caveman
